summary: Unified resource management for prompts, gates, and frameworks. Use resource_type to specify the resource kind, then action for the operation.

toolDescription.description:
🗂️ RESOURCE MANAGER: CRUD for prompts, gates, frameworks.

resource_manager(resource_type, action, id?, name?, description?)

TYPES: prompt | gate | framework
ACTIONS: create | update | delete | list | inspect | reload | guide | switch | history | rollback | compare

UPDATE: update(id, description:"new") — only provided fields change. inspect(id, detail:"full") to see current content first.

VERSIONING: history (view versions), rollback (restore), compare (diff versions)

CREATION GUIDES:
• >>create_framework - Framework creation with validation
• >>create_gate - Quality gate creation
• >>create_prompt - Prompt/chain creation

frameworkAware.enabled: 🗂️ RESOURCE MANAGER [FRAMEWORK]: Operations reflect active framework context.
frameworkAware.disabled: 🗂️ RESOURCE MANAGER: Standard resource lifecycle operations.

parameters.name: resource_type
parameters.description: Type of resource to manage. Routes to appropriate handler.

parameters.name: action
parameters.description: Operation to perform. Type-specific: analyze_type/guide (prompt), switch (framework). Versioning: history/rollback/compare (prompt/gate/framework).

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Resource identifier. Required for create, update, delete, inspect, reload, switch.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Human-friendly name for the resource (create/update).

parameters.name: description
parameters.description: Resource description explaining its purpose (create/update).

parameters.name: enabled_only
parameters.description: Filter list to enabled resources only. Default: true.

parameters.name: confirm
parameters.description: Required `true` for destructive actions — `delete` and `rollback` both refuse without it. Deletion cannot be undone: rollback cannot restore a deleted prompt.

parameters.name: reason
parameters.description: Audit reason for reload/delete/switch operations.

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: [Prompt] Category tag for the prompt.

parameters.name: user_message_template
parameters.description: [Prompt] Prompt body/template with Nunjucks placeholders.

parameters.name: system_message
parameters.description: [Prompt] Optional system message for the prompt.

parameters.name: arguments
parameters.description: [Prompt] Argument definitions for the prompt. `type` is one of string|number|boolean|array|object. `required` and `defaultValue` are persisted to the prompt's YAML; `validation` accepts pattern/minLength/maxLength and is what arms required-argument enforcement at execution.

parameters.name: argument_updates
parameters.description: [Prompt] Update-only: per-field overlay onto EXISTING arguments, addressed by `name`. `name` must match an argument this prompt already declares — no upsert, so adding/removing/renaming an argument still requires the full `arguments` array. Every other field overlays onto the matched entry only when supplied; an omitted field leaves that entry's current value untouched. Mutually exclusive with `arguments` in the same call. Rejected on `create`. Combine with `dry_run: true` to preview.

parameters.name: patch
parameters.description: [Prompt] Anchored edits applied server-side on `update`, so one section can be changed without resending the rest. `field` is user_message_template|system_message|description; `old_string` must match the current text EXACTLY (whitespace included) and uniquely, otherwise the update is rejected naming the anchor and its occurrence count; `new_string` may be empty to delete. Operations apply in order. Pass `replace_all: true` to accept a multi-occurrence anchor. Mutually exclusive with `user_message_template`/`system_message` in the same call. Combine with `dry_run: true` to preview.

parameters.name: source_workspace
parameters.description: [Versioning] Read version history belonging to a DIFFERENT workspace. `state.db` is one file shared by every project on the machine, isolated by workspace id alone, so another checkout's history is already present and merely filtered out. READ-ONLY and scope-local-on-write: honoured by `history` and `compare`; every other action REJECTS it rather than ignoring it, because a snapshot recorded elsewhere describes files that may not exist here and version numbering is per-workspace. Inspect with it, then apply the change in that workspace.

parameters.name: dry_run
parameters.description: Preview a mutation instead of performing it — nothing is written and no version is recorded. `update` (prompt): returns the resulting text bodies and the diff, for a full update or a `patch`. `rollback` (prompt|gate|framework): returns the diff between the current state and the version you would restore, and still refuses a version whose snapshot is incomplete. `delete` (prompt|gate|framework): reports what would be removed, including the prompts that reference it. Not valid on `create` — there is nothing to diff against.

parameters.name: chain_steps
parameters.description: [Prompt] Chain steps definition for multi-step prompts.

parameters.name: tools
parameters.description: [Prompt] Script tools to create with the prompt. Each tool creates files in tools/{id}/ subdirectory. Required: id, name, script. Optional: description, runtime (python|node|shell|auto), schema (JSON Schema object), trigger (schema_match|explicit|always|never), confirm, strict, timeout.

parameters.name: gate_configuration
parameters.description: [Prompt] Gate configuration: include (array), exclude (array), framework_gates (boolean).

parameters.name: injection
parameters.description: [Prompt] Prompt-level injection control. Keys: system-prompt, gate-guidance, style-guidance; each takes {enabled?: boolean, frequency?: {mode: every|first-only|never, interval?: number}, target?: steps|gates|both}. A prompt's own declaration outranks the chain or category it runs inside. Omit to leave the prompt's existing block untouched.

parameters.name: register_with_mcp
parameters.description: [Prompt] Whether this prompt registers as a native MCP prompt. FREEZE HAZARD: this value is normally resolved prompt -> category -> global -> default true; setting it writes an explicit prompt-level value that overrides all three permanently, so the prompt stops following any later change to its category or global default. Omit unless this prompt must differ from its category.

parameters.name: mcp_prompt_mode
parameters.description: [Prompt] Native MCP prompt behaviour: expand (plain template text) or launch (route through prompt_engine). FREEZE HAZARD: normally resolved prompt -> category -> default expand; an explicit value overrides both permanently and the prompt stops following any later change to its category default. Omit unless this prompt must differ from its category.

parameters.name: subagent_model
parameters.description: [Prompt] Client-agnostic capability hint for this prompt's ==> delegated steps.

parameters.name: agent_type
parameters.description: [Prompt] Default host agent for this prompt's ==> delegated steps. A step's own agentType overrides it; neither present falls back to chain-executor.

parameters.name: execution_hint
parameters.description: [Prompt] Hint for execution type on creation.

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: [Prompt] List filter query.

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: [Prompt] Output format for list/inspect.

parameters.name: detail
parameters.description: [Prompt] Detail level for list/inspect. summary=IDs only, full=complete prompt content.

parameters.name: search_query
parameters.description: [Prompt] Search query for filtering (list action).

parameters.name: gate_type
parameters.description: [Gate] Gate type: validation (pass/fail) or guidance (advisory). Default: validation.

parameters.name: guidance
parameters.description: [Gate] Gate guidance content - the criteria or instructions.

parameters.name: pass_criteria
parameters.description: [Gate] Structured pass criteria definitions.

parameters.name: activation
parameters.description: [Gate] Activation rules: prompt_categories, frameworks, explicit_request.

parameters.name: retry_config
parameters.description: [Gate] Retry configuration: max_attempts, improvement_hints.

parameters.name: framework
parameters.description: [Framework] Framework type identifier. Use action:'list' to see registered frameworks.

parameters.name: system_prompt_guidance
parameters.description: [Framework] System prompt guidance injected when active.

parameters.name: phases
parameters.description: [Framework] Phase definitions and advanced fields. Core: id, name, description. Advanced fields (framework_gates, processing_steps, execution_steps, etc.) are also accepted.

parameters.name: gates
parameters.description: [Framework] Gate configuration: include, exclude arrays.

parameters.name: tool_descriptions
parameters.description: [Framework] Tool description overlays when active.

parameters.name: enabled
parameters.description: [Framework] Whether the framework is enabled.

parameters.name: persist
parameters.description: [Framework] For switch: persist the change to config. Default: false.

parameters.name: version
parameters.description: [Versioning] Target version number for rollback action.

parameters.name: from_version
parameters.description: [Versioning] Starting version number for compare action.

parameters.name: to_version
parameters.description: [Versioning] Ending version number for compare action.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: [Versioning] Max versions to return in history. Default: 10.

parameters.name: skip_version
parameters.description: [Versioning] Skip auto-versioning on update. Default: false.
